messages:
viv: opened PR w/ a new "Eclipse Slate" dark theme exploration. main asks: swatches in the theme picker, sparkline legibility on dense charts, and slightly warmer strings in code blocks. screenshots + a tiny GIF in the PR.

sam: loading now. nice direction — two quick things: the swatch preview thumbnails use tiny borders and look floated on OLED. add a 1px inner divider so they read as separate cards.

oliver: sparkline feedback: at 1px the lines vanish against panel noise at 60% zoom. propose default 1px but render an on-hover 2px halo (no layout shift). also add an anti-alias smoothing rule for subpixel rendering.

tess: a11y check: small legend labels at 12px still fail contrast on the slate bg (~3.7:1). bump to 13px and use semantic token --text-primary on titles. also we should ensure keyboard focus is visible on swatches in the picker (3px ring).

kai: color palette: avoid red/green pairs for categorical series. suggest using a tested CVD-safe set for dark surfaces: ["#8ad3bf","#c5a9e8","#ffb07a","#79b6ff","#ffd36a"]. for heatmaps, use a single-hue sequential (amber 40->95%) so hotspots are obvious and sims read well.

viv: thanks — adding action items: 1) swatch border + preview thumbnail states; 2) sparkline hover halo + improved smoothing; 3) bump legend font + focus ring; 4) palette swap to kai's set; 5) amber sequential heatmap. also updating PR description with an accessibility checklist.

sam: small copy tweak: in Settings change "Enable dark mode" -> "Theme: Light / Dark / OLED" (shorter & clearer). and change the theme switch tooltip to "Switch UI brightness" -> "Theme controls UI brightness and contrast".

oliver: code syntax suggestion: keywords #c8a8ff, strings #ffb86a, functions/ids #7fbfff. inline code bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.03) to lift spans off true-black panels. that spacing helps scanning.

tess: UX nit: when user hovers a swatch in the picker show an inline label with the token names (accent-action, surface-900, panel-700) for designers — helps avoid hex guessing. also add a copy-hex button. tiny but helpful.

kai: add a stylelint rule suggestion in the PR: forbid hex literals inside components; require tokens. plus a lint rule that treats token names as semantic (accent-action) not ordinal (accent-1). keeps cross-theme parity.

viv: quick CSS vars snippet I'm prototyping:

```css
:root {
  --surface-900: #060708; /* eclipse-slate */
  --panel-700: #0d0f11;
  --text-primary: #e8eef6;
  --muted-1: #99a7ae;
  --accent-action: #7fb8ff;
  --accent-strong: #5f8cff;
}
```

viv: also added a tiny "contrast-overlay" dev flag in storybook so reviewers can toggle a 4.5:1 overlay to inspect failing elements quickly. pinging @tess for a11y runs.

design-bot: PR #3137 opened by viv (branch/eclipse-slate). visual-diff report created: 5 images added, 1 flagged (legend-contrast). CI artifacts -> https://ci.internal/reports/3137

sam: i'll re-run the contrast audit once you push the legend bump. also can you add a preview thumbnail for theme selector in the Account menu? feels much faster for QA.

oliver: one more micro-thing: on tiny metrics cards (<280px), collapse legend into a single overflow pill that opens a popover instead of wrapping. reduces layout thrash.

tess: happy with the plan. offer: I can attach colorblind simulation images once the palette is in the branch. ping me @tess and I'll add them to the PR comments. :mag:

viv: great — updating PR with all items. will re-run CI and merge after visuals pass. thanks team :sparkles:
